node: Campus bookstore, course-material access, and publisher-distribution layer
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a narrow public universe around campus course-material distribution. The most direct underfollowed public operator is Barnes & Noble Education, with Wiley as a mid-cap academic-content supplier exposed to inclusive access and digital courseware. Pearson is the obvious reference leader for higher-education courseware. American Public Education is included as a small-cap institutional customer/operator whose curriculum, LMS, testing, and course-content vendor dependencies may reveal downstream pricing pressure from the node. Private companies such as Follett, Cengage, McGraw Hill, VitalSource, Instructure, and D2L appear important but are outside the US-listed universe for this pass.
